digest.en: The death toll in Japan's earthquake has risen to 17, with aftershocks and heat complicating rescue efforts in the affected areas. Meanwhile, the US military has launched new strikes on Iran, escalating tensions in the region. Ukraine's online retailers and gas stations are becoming new battlefields in the ongoing conflict.

articles.summary: Like few other countries, Taiwan faces a legitimate existential crisis. There is zero doubt this would result in the destruction of Taiwan’s democratic political system and liberal political culture.
